```yaml
name: Database Export

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # every Sunday at 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  export-db:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      packages: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Load secrets from 1Password
        uses: 1password/load-secrets-action@v3
        with:
          version: '3.0.0'
          unset-previous: true
          export-env: true

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Export SQLite database
        env:
          PROTECTED_ENDPOINT_URL: ${{ env.PROTECTED_ENDPOINT_URL }}
          PROTECTED_ENDPOINT_TOKEN: ${{ env.PROTECTED_ENDPOINT_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # The script should sanitize and bundle the SQLite database
          npx ts-node scripts/export-db.ts

      - name: Upload database artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: sanitized-db
          path: dist/database.sqlite
          retention-days: 30
          compression-level: 9
```
